```typescriptreact
            ) : (
                <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无数据</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
            )}
        </div>
    );

    const renderTransactionPanel = (variant: 'half' | 'full' = 'half') => (
        <div className={`${styles.tablePanel} ${variant === 'full' ? styles.tablePanelFull : ''}`}>
            <div className={styles.tablePanelHeader}>
                <div className={styles.tablePanelTitle}>最新交易</div>
                <Tag color="processing" style={{ borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 10, padding: '0 10px' }}>
                    最近15条
                </Tag>
            </div>
            {transactions.length > 0 ? (
                <div className={`${styles.tableContainer} ${variant === 'full' ? styles.equalHeightTableFull : styles.equalHeightTable}`}>
                    <Table
                        dataSource={transactions.slice(0, 15)}
                        columns={transactionColumns}
                        rowKey="hash"
                        pagination={false}
                        size="small"
                        className={`${styles.table} ${styles.compactTable}`}
                        tableLayout="fixed"
                        rowClassName={compactRowClass}
                    />
                </div>
            ) : (
                <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无数据</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
            )}
        </div>
    );

    const explorerTabs: { key: 'overview' | 'blocks' | 'transactions'; label: string }[] = [
        { key: 'overview', label: '总览' },
        { key: 'blocks', label: '区块' },
        { key: 'transactions', label: '交易' },
    ];

    const ExplorerMetaGrid = ({ items }: { items: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }[] }) => (
        <div className={styles.resultMetaGrid}>
            {items.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.label} className={styles.resultMetaItem}>
                    <span className={styles.resultLabel}>{item.label}</span>
                    <span className={styles.resultValue}>{item.value ?? '--'}</span>
                </div>
            ))}
        </div>
    );

    const renderBlockDetail = (detail: ExplorerBlockDetail) => (
        <div className={styles.resultCard}>
            <div className={styles.resultHeader}>
                <div>
                    <div className={styles.resultTitle}>区块 #{detail.blockNumber}</div>
                    <div className={styles.resultSubtitle}>{new Date(detail.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</div>
                </div>
                <Tag color="success" className={styles.resultTag}>{detail.status}</Tag>
            </div>
            <ExplorerMetaGrid
                items={[
                    { label: '区块哈希', value: detail.hash },
                    { label: '父区块哈希', value: detail.parentHash },
                    { label: '状态根', value: detail.stateRoot },
                    { label: '交易根', value: detail.extrinsicsRoot },
                    { label: 'Collator', value: detail.collator },
                ]}
            />
            <div className={styles.resultSection}>
                <div className={styles.resultSectionHeader}>
                    <span className={styles.resultSectionTitle}>包含交易</span>
                    <Tag color="processing" className={styles.sectionTag}>{detail.extrinsics.length} 条</Tag>
                </div>
                {detail.extrinsics.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className={styles.resultList}>
                        {detail.extrinsics.map((ext) => (
                            <div key={ext.hash} className={styles.resultListItem}>
                                <div className={styles.resultListPrimary}>
                                    <span className={styles.resultBadge}>#{ext.index}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultMethod}>{ext.method}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultHash}>{truncateMiddle(ext.hash, 10, 8)}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className={styles.resultListSecondary}>
                                    签名者：{truncateMiddle(ext.signer, 10, 8)}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <Empty
                        description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无交易</span>}
                        image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
                    />
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );

    const renderTransactionDetail = (detail: ExplorerTransactionDetail) => (
        <div className={styles.resultCard}>
            <div className={styles.resultHeader}>
                <div>
                    <div className={styles.resultTitle}>交易 {truncateMiddle(detail.hash, 12, 8)}</div>
                    <div className={styles.resultSubtitle}>
                        区块 #{detail.blockNumber} · {new Date(detail.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <Tag color={detail.status === 'success' ? 'success' : 'error'} className={styles.resultTag}>
                    {detail.status === 'success' ? '成功' : detail.status}
                </Tag>
            </div>
            <ExplorerMetaGrid
                items={[
                    { label: '交易哈希', value: detail.hash },
                    { label: '区块哈希', value: detail.blockHash },
                    { label: '调用方法', value: detail.method },
                    { label: '签名者', value: detail.signer },
                ]}
            />
            {detail.args?.length > 0 && (
                <div className={styles.resultSection}>
                    <div className={styles.resultSectionHeader}>
                        <span className={styles.resultSectionTitle}>参数</span>
                        <Tag color="default" className={styles.sectionTag}>{detail.args.length} 项</Tag>
                    </div>
                    <div className={styles.resultList}>
                        {detail.args.map((arg, idx) => (
                            <div key={idx} className={styles.argItem}>
                                {typeof arg === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(arg) : String(arg)}
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );

    const renderAccountDetail = (detail: ExplorerAccountDetail) => (
        <div className={styles.resultCard}>
            <div className={styles.resultHeader}>
                <div>
                    <div className={styles.resultTitle}>账户 {truncateMiddle(detail.account.address, 10, 8)}</div>
                    <div className={styles.resultSubtitle}>最近交易 {detail.transactions.items.length} 条</div>
                </div>
                <Tag color="processing" className={styles.resultTag}>账户</Tag>
            </div>
            <ExplorerMetaGrid
                items={[
                    { label: '账户地址', value: detail.account.address },
                    { label: 'Nonce', value: detail.account.nonce },
                    { label: '可用余额', value: detail.account.free },
                    { label: '冻结余额', value: detail.account.miscFrozen },
                ]}
            />
            <div className={styles.resultSection}>
                <div className={styles.resultSectionHeader}>
                    <span className={styles.resultSectionTitle}>最近交易</span>
                    <Tag color="processing" className={styles.sectionTag}>
                        第 {detail.transactions.page} 页
                    </Tag>
                </div>
                {detail.transactions.items.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className={styles.resultList}>
                        {detail.transactions.items.map((item) => (
                            <div key={item.hash} className={styles.resultListItem}>
                                <div className={styles.resultListPrimary}>
                                    <span className={styles.resultHash}>{truncateMiddle(item.hash, 12, 8)}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultMethod}>{item.method}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultBadge}>#{item.blockNumber}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className={styles.resultListSecondary}>
                                    {new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <Empty
                        description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无交易记录</span>}
                        image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
                    />
                )}
                <div className={styles.resultPagination}>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        ghost
                        disabled={searchPage === 1 || searchLoading}
                        onClick={() => handleAccountPageChange('prev')}
                    >
                        上一页
                    </Button>
                    <span>第 {detail.transactions.page} 页</span>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        type="primary"
                        disabled={!detail.transactions.hasMore || searchLoading}
                        loading={searchLoading && detail.transactions.hasMore}
                        onClick={() => handleAccountPageChange('next')}
                    >
                        下一页
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );

    if (loading && !dashboardData && !error) {
        return (
            <div className={styles.dashboardContainer}>
                <div className={styles.loadingContainer}>
                    <Spin size="large" />
                    <Text style={{ color: '#fff', marginTop: 16, display: 'block' }}>加载数据中...</Text>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // 显示错误
    if (error) {
        return (
            <div className={styles.dashboardContainer}>
                <div className={styles.loadingContainer}>
                    <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{error}</span>} />
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    // 兜底：如果没在加载，没错误，但数据仍然是 null (例如所有 API 失败但未捕获为 error)
    if (!dashboardData) {
        return (
            <div className={styles.dashboardContainer}>
                <div className={styles.loadingContainer}>
                    <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无数据</span>} />
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div className={styles.dashboardContainer}>
            {/* 顶部标题栏 */}
            <div className={styles.header}>
                <div className={styles.headerLeft}>
                    {/* <div className={styles.heroBadge}>
                        <BlockOutlined /> 链上态势可视化大屏
                    </div> */}
                    <Title level={2} className={styles.title}>
                        <span className={styles.titleLogo}>
                            <Image src="/logo.png" alt="平台 Logo" width={52} height={52} priority />
                        </span>
                        链计算业务数据大屏
                    </Title>
                    {/* <Text className={styles.subtitle}>实时展示链上链下关键指标、拓扑态势与激励状态</Text> */}
                </div>
                <div className={styles.headerRight}>
                    <ClockCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#00e5ff' }} />
                    <Text className={styles.timeText}>{formatTime(currentTime)}</Text>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* 主要内容区域 */}
            <div className={styles.content}>
                {/* 左侧列 */}
                <div className={styles.leftColumn}>
                    {/* Worker资源数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="Worker资源数据"
                        titleIcon={<DesktopOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow4}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总节点数"
                                value={dashboardData?.workers.total || 0}
                                prefix={<GlobalOutlined />}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#00e5ff', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="在线节点"
                                value={dashboardData?.workers.online || 0}
                                prefix={<GlobalOutlined />}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="离线"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.offline || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#ff4d4f', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="无响应"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.unresponsive || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        {workerMonitorData?.workers && workerMonitorData.workers.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.tableContainer}>
                                <Table
                                    dataSource={workerMonitorData.workers.slice(0, 3)}
                                    columns={workerColumns}
                                    rowKey="id"
                                    pagination={false}
                                    size="small"
                                    className={styles.table}
                                />
                            </div>
                        )}
                        {workerTypeChips.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.chipRow}>
                                {workerTypeChips.map((chip) => (
                                    <div key={chip.key} className={styles.statChip}>
                                        <span className={styles.chipLabel}>{chip.label}</span>
                                        <strong>{chip.online}/{chip.total}</strong>
                                        <span className={styles.chipSub}>在线</span>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 激励数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="用户激励数据"
                        titleIcon={<TrophyOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总激励金额"
                                value={incentiveData?.totalAmount || 0}
                                precision={2}
                                suffix="PHA"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="平均评分"
                                value={incentiveData?.averageScore || 256}
                                precision={1}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        {rewardDistributionData.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={`${styles.chartContainer} ${styles.rewardChart}`}>
                                <ReactECharts
                                    option={{
                                        ...workerDistributionOption,
                                        series: [
                                            {
                                                ...workerDistributionOption.series[0],
                                                data: rewardDistributionData.map((item: any) => ({
                                                    value: item.value,
                                                    name: item.type,
                                                })),
                                            },
                                        ],
                                    }}
                                    style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}
                                />
                            </div>
                        )}
                        {recentRewards.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.rewardList}>
                                {recentRewards.map((reward) => (
                                    <div key={`${reward.blockNumber}-${reward.timestamp}`} className={styles.rewardItem}>
                                        <div>
                                            <span className={styles.rewardAmount}>{reward.amount} PHA</span>
                                            <span className={styles.rewardMeta}>区块 #{reward.blockNumber}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <span className={styles.rewardTime}>
                                            {new Date(reward.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                                        </span>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    <DataCard
                        title="运行态势速览"
                        titleIcon={<GlobalOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.snapshotGrid}>
                            {systemSnapshot.highlights.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.label} className={styles.snapshotCard}>
                                    <span className={styles.snapshotLabel}>{item.label}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.snapshotValue}>{item.value}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.snapshotDesc}>{item.desc}</span>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.snapshotProgress}>
                            {systemSnapshot.bars.map((bar) => (
                                <div key={bar.label} className={styles.progressItem}>
                                    <div className={styles.progressLabelRow}>
                                        <span>{bar.label}</span>
                                        <span>{bar.value}%</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                        <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${bar.value}%` }} />
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.timelineList}>
                            {systemSnapshot.timeline.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.key} className={styles.timelineItem}>
                                    <div>
                                        <div className={styles.timelineTitle}>{item.title}</div>
                                        <div className={styles.timelineMeta}>{item.value}</div>
                                    </div>
                                    <span className={styles.timelineTime}>{item.time}</span>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 中间主区域 */}
                <div className={styles.centerColumn}>
                    {/* 区块浏览器（含核心指标） */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="区块链上数据"
                        titleIcon={<TransactionOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        {/* 第一行：核心指标 */}
                        <Row gutter={[12, 12]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="区块高度"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.blockNumber || 0}
                                    prefix={<BlockOutlined />}
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#00e5ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="出块间隔"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.avgBlockTime || 0}
                                    precision={2}
                                    suffix="秒"
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="系统健康度"
                                    value={dashboardData?.system.health || 100}
                                    suffix="%"
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="共识节点"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.consensusNodes || 0}
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#1890ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                        </Row>

                        <div className={styles.explorerToolbar}>
                            <div className={styles.viewSwitch}>
                                {explorerTabs.map((tab) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={tab.key}
                                        type="button"
                                        className={`${styles.viewSwitchButton} ${explorerView === tab.key ? styles.viewSwitchButtonActive : ''}`}
                                        onClick={() => handleExplorerViewChange(tab.key)}
                                    >
                                        {tab.label}
                                    </button>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                            <div className={styles.searchConsole}>
                                <Select
                                    value={searchType}
                                    className={styles.searchSelect}
                                    options={searchOptions}
                                    onChange={(value: ExplorerSearchType) => {
                                        setSearchType(value);
                                        setSearchError(null);
                                    }}
                                    dropdownMatchSelectWidth={false}
                                />
                                <div className={styles.searchInputGroup}>
                                    <div className={styles.searchInputWrapper}>
                                        <Input
                                            value={searchValue}
                                            onChange={(e) => {
                                                setSearchValue(e.target.value);
                                                if (searchError) {
                                                    setSearchError(null);
                                                }
                                            }}
                                            placeholder={searchPlaceholderMap[searchType]}
                                            className={styles.searchInput}
                                            allowClear
                                            bordered={false}
                                            onPressEnter={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                    <Button
                                        type="primary"
                                        icon={<SearchOutlined />}
                                        className={styles.searchButton}
                                        loading={searchLoading}
                                        onClick={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                    >
                                        检索
                                    </Button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {searchError && (
                            <div className={styles.searchError}>{searchError}</div>
                        )}

                        {shouldShowSearchResult && searchResult ? (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {searchResult.type === 'block' && renderBlockDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'transaction' && renderTransactionDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'account' && renderAccountDetail(searchResult.data)}
                            </div>
                        ) : explorerView === 'overview' ? (
                            <div className={styles.dualTables}>
                                {renderBlockPanel()}
                                {renderTransactionPanel()}
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {explorerView === 'blocks' ? renderBlockPanel('full') : renderTransactionPanel('full')}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 右侧列 */}
                <div className={styles.rightColumn}>
                    {/* 密钥轮换 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="密钥轮换数据"
                        titleIcon={<KeyOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow3}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总密钥数"
                                value={keyRotationData?.totalKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#722ed1', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃密钥"
                                value={keyRotationData?.activeKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="轮换中"
                                value={keyRotationData?.rotatingKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.infoBox} style={{ marginTop: '8px', padding: '8px 12px' }}>
                            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                                下次轮换: 区块 #{keyRotationData?.nextRotation?.estimatedBlock || 0}
                            </Text>
                        </div>
                        {recentRotations.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.timelineList}>
                                {recentRotations.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={`${item.epoch}-${item.blockNumber}`} className={styles.timelineItem}>
                                        <div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineTitle}>Epoch {item.epoch}</div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineMeta}>区块 #{item.blockNumber}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <Tag color={item.success ? 'success' : 'error'}>
                                            {item.success ? '完成' : '失败'}
                                        </Tag>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 服务调度 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="安全调度数据"
                        titleIcon={<ThunderboltOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="资源利用率"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.systemHealth || 100}
                                suffix="%"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#13c2c2', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="平均响应时间"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.averageResponseTime || 0}
                                suffix="ms"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.infoBox}>
                            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                                服务调度根据 Worker 在线率和响应时间动态分配任务，确保高负载场景下的稳定性与吞吐。
                            </Text>
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.serviceGrid}>
                            {serviceInsights.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.label} className={styles.serviceTile}>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceLabel}>{item.label}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceValue}>{item.value}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceDesc}>{item.desc}</div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 合约数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="智能合约数据"
                        titleIcon={<FileProtectOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总合约数"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.total || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#722ed1', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃合约"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.active || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.tagContainer}>
                            {Object.entries(dashboardData?.contracts.byType || {}).map(([type, count]) => (
                                <Tag key={type} color="purple" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                                    {type}: {count as number}
                                </Tag>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        {contractHighlights.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.contractList}>
                                {contractHighlights.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={item.type} className={styles.contractItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.contractMetaRow}>
                                            <span className={styles.contractType}>{item.type}</span>
                                            <span className={styles.contractCount}>{item.count} 个</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                            <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${item.ratio}%` }} />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                    </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
```

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 6px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.subtitle {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.headerRight {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.timeText {
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 380px;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 数据卡片 - 使用 portalCard 风格 */
.dataCard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* 覆盖 DataCard 的样式以匹配 portal 风格 */
.dataCard :global(.card) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92)) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dataCard :global(.header) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dataCard :global(.title) {
    color: #f6f7ff !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.dataCard :global(.content) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 14px !important;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* 统计行 */
.statRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* 3列统计行 */
.statRow3 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* 4列统计行 */
.statRow4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* 修复核心指标模块的字体颜色 */
.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
}

/* 图表容器 */
.chartContainer {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 200px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.rewardChart {
    height: 230px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}

/* 表格容器 */
.tableContainer {
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable {
    height: 360px;
}

.equalHeightTableFull {
    height: 360px;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-wrapper) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-wrapper),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

.table {
    background: transparent;
}

.table :global(.ant-table) {
    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-body) {
    max-height: none;
    overflow: visible;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-thead > tr > th) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr:hover > td) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

.compactRow {
    height: 28px;
}

.compactRow td {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

.dualTables {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}

.explorerToolbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.searchConsole {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 320px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.85), rgba(10, 32, 78, 0.85));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), 0 10px 20px rgba(0, 12, 35, 0.5);
}

.searchSelect {
    min-width: 110px;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selector) {
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    height: 32px !important;
    line-height: 32px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-arrow) {
    color: #fff !important;
}

.searchInputGroup {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 220px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    height: 32px !important;
}

.searchInput::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.resultValue {
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.resultListSecondary {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.resultBadge {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.resultMethod {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.resultHash {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}

.argItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```

```css
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.timeText {
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 380px;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 数据卡片 - 使用 portalCard 风格 */
.dataCard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* 覆盖 DataCard 的样式以匹配 portal 风格 */
.dataCard :global(.card) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92)) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dataCard :global(.header) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dataCard :global(.title) {
    color: #f6f7ff !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.dataCard :global(.content) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 14px !important;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* 统计行 */
.statRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* 3列统计行 */
.statRow3 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* 4列统计行 */
.statRow4 {

    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;

}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* 修复核心指标模块的字体颜色 */
.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* 图表容器 */
.chartContainer {

/* 表格容器 */
.tableContainer {

.equalHeightTable {

}

}

}

}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-container) {

    display: flex;

}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-body) {

}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-wrapper),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table),

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;

@media (max-width: 1366px) {

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {

}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```

### 主要调整
- `page.tsx`
  - 将顶部标题替换为 `logo.png + “链计算业务数据大屏”`，引入 `next/image`。
  - 新增运行态势速览模块（高亮卡片、进度条、激励时间线）。
  - “用户激励数据”补充最新奖励列表；“Worker资源数据”增加TEE类型分布标签。
  - 右侧各卡片（密钥轮换、安全调度、智能合约）扩展时间线、统计平铺、进度条等内容，填充空白区域。
  - 数据衍生逻辑：新增多组 `useMemo`（worker 类型、奖励、调度洞察、系统快照、合约高亮等）。
- `dashboard.module.css`
  - 收紧布局 gap，标题样式支持 logo。
  - 新增大量与检索结果/新增模块匹配的风格类（chip、reward list、snapshot、progress、timeline、service grid、contract list 等）。
  - 统一按钮/进度条/卡片视觉，让各模块内容充实无空白。

### 测试建议
- 运行前端并查看数据大屏：确认模块间缝隙更小、标题显示 logo。
- 检查左列新增模块及各卡片补充内容在不同数据状态（有/无数据）下展示是否正常。

---

**User**

1. 用户激励的饼状图太大导致下面的图例超出该模块内容，将饼状图变小
2. “运行态势速览”模块改成“TEE可信验证”，主要包括SGX和CSV两种TEE
3.左右两列上下模块间的间隙也要再小一点
4. 最新区块和最新交易的每一条数据没有对齐，两者每一条数据的高度要保持一致，另外最新交易陈列15条数据后已经超出最外侧模块框的边界了，修改。
5. 区块搜索框的最外层可以去掉，和左侧总览、区块、交易的横条在一行且高度一致

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */

}

.timelineTitle {

}

.timelineMeta {

}

.timelineTime {

}

.serviceGrid {

    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

    margin-top: 12px;
}

.serviceTile {

    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.serviceLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.serviceValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.serviceDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {

    font-size: 12px;
}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.heroBadge {

    padding: 6px 14px;

    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.subtitle {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);

    font-weight: 400;
}

.headerRight {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.timeText {

}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 380px;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

}

.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;

}

}

.snapshotProgress {

}

.progressTrack {

.progressFill {

}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;

}

.timelineItem {

    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;

}

.timelineTitle {

.timelineMeta {

.timelineTime {

.serviceGrid {

}

.serviceTile {

.serviceLabel {

.serviceValue {
    font-size: 16px;

}

.serviceDesc {
    font-size: 11px;

}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;

    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;

}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;

}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.heroBadge {

    padding: 6px 14px;

    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    border-radius: 14px;

}

.subtitle {

}

.headerRight {

    gap: 8px;

.timeText {

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 380px;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

}

}

.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {

}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;

.rewardList {

}

.rewardTime {

}

.snapshotGrid {

    gap: 10px;

}

.snapshotCard {

}

}

    font-size: 11px;

}

.snapshotProgress {

}

.progressLabelRow {

}

.progressTrack {

}

.progressFill {

}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;

.timelineItem {

}

.serviceGrid {

}

.serviceTile {

.serviceDesc {

}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;

    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```

我先把间距、表格高度和搜索条样式统一调整掉，再把“运行态势速览”替换成TEE可信验证的内容。接着会微调最新区块/交易的行高和滚动区域，保证15条数据不越界。

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

    align-items: center;

}
```
