            <div className={styles.resultSection}>
                <div className={styles.resultSectionHeader}>
                    <span className={styles.resultSectionTitle}>最近交易</span>
                    <Tag color="processing" className={styles.sectionTag}>
                        第 {detail.transactions.page} 页
                    </Tag>
                </div>
                {detail.transactions.items.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className={styles.resultList}>
                        {detail.transactions.items.map((item) => (
                            <div key={item.hash} className={styles.resultListItem}>
                                <div className={styles.resultListPrimary}>
                                    <span className={styles.resultHash}>{truncateMiddle(item.hash, 12, 8)}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultMethod}>{item.method}</span>
                                    <span className={styles.resultBadge}>#{item.blockNumber}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className={styles.resultListSecondary}>
                                    {new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <Empty
                        description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无交易记录</span>}
                        image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
                    />
                )}
                <div className={styles.resultPagination}>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        ghost
                        disabled={searchPage === 1 || searchLoading}
                        onClick={() => handleAccountPageChange('prev')}
                    >
                        上一页
                        </Button>
                    <span>第 {detail.transactions.page} 页</span>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        type="primary"
                        disabled={!detail.transactions.hasMore || searchLoading}
                        loading={searchLoading && detail.transactions.hasMore}
                        onClick={() => handleAccountPageChange('next')}
                    >
                        下一页
                    </Button>
                    </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );

    return (
        <div className={styles.dashboardContainer}>
            {/* 顶部标题栏 */}
            <div className={styles.header}>
                <div className={styles.headerLeft}>
                    {/* <div className={styles.heroBadge}>
                        <BlockOutlined /> 链上态势可视化大屏
                    </div> */}
                    <Title level={2} className={styles.title}>
                        <span className={styles.titleLogo}>
                            <Image src="/whitelogo.png" alt="平台 Logo" width={180} height={55} priority />
                        </span>
                        链计算业务数据大屏
                    </Title>
                    {/* <Text className={styles.subtitle}>实时展示链上链下关键指标、拓扑态势与激励状态</Text> */}
                </div>
                <div className={styles.headerRight}>
                    <div className={styles.refreshControls}>
                        <Button
                            type={autoRefresh ? 'primary' : 'default'}
                            onClick={() => setAutoRefresh((prev) => !prev)}
                        >
                            {autoRefresh ? '自动刷新：开启' : '自动刷新：关闭'}
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                            onClick={() => loadDashboardData()}
                            loading={loading}
                        >
                            手动刷新
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                    <div className={styles.timeBadge}>
                        <ClockCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#00e5ff' }} />
                        <Text className={styles.timeText}>{formatTime(currentTime)}</Text>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* 主要内容区域 */}
            <div className={styles.content}>
                {/* 左侧列 */}
                <div className={styles.leftColumn}>
                    {/* Worker资源数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="Worker资源数据"
                        titleIcon={<DesktopOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow4}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总节点数"
                                value={dashboardData?.workers.total || 0}
                                prefix={<GlobalOutlined />}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#00e5ff', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="在线节点"
                                value={dashboardData?.workers.online || 0}
                                prefix={<GlobalOutlined />}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="离线"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.offline || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#ff4d4f', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="无响应"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.unresponsive || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        {workerTableData.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={`${styles.tableContainer} ${styles.workerTable}`}>
                                <Table
                                    dataSource={workerTableData}
                                    columns={workerColumns}
                                    rowKey={(record: any, index) => record?.id || record?.publicKey || record?.key || index}
                                    pagination={false}
                                    size="small"
                                    className={`${styles.table} ${styles.compactTable}`}
                                    rowClassName={compactRowClass}
                                />
                                {shouldPaginateWorkers && (
                                    <div className={styles.tablePagination}>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            ghost
                                            disabled={workerPage === 1}
                                            onClick={() => setWorkerPage((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                                        >
                                            上一页
                                        </Button>
                                        <span>第 {workerPage} / {workerTotalPages} 页</span>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            type="primary"
                                            disabled={workerPage === workerTotalPages}
                                            onClick={() => setWorkerPage((prev) => Math.min(workerTotalPages, prev + 1))}
                                        >
                                            下一页
                                        </Button>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                                {workerCount === 1 && (
                                    <div className={styles.workerNotice}>
                                        当前仅有 1 个 Worker 在线，更多节点正在接入...
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 激励数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="用户激励数据"
                        titleIcon={<TrophyOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总激励金额"
                                value={incentiveData?.totalAmount || 0}
                                precision={2}
                                suffix="PHA"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="平均评分"
                                value={incentiveAverageScore}
                                precision={2}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>

                        <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                            <div>
                                <div className={styles.sectionTitle}>账户列表</div>
                                <div className={styles.sectionSubtitle}>已连接 {totalIncentiveAccounts} 个账户</div>
                            </div>
                            {totalRewardFormatted && (
                                <Tag color="processing" style={{ borderRadius: 999, padding: '0 12px', height: 24, lineHeight: '22px' }}>
                                    {totalRewardFormatted} PHA
                                </Tag>
                            )}
                        </div>

                        {displayedIncentiveAccounts.length > 0 ? (
                            <div className={styles.accountList}>
                                {displayedIncentiveAccounts.map((account) => (
                                    <div key={account.address} className={styles.accountItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.accountHeader}>
                                            <Tooltip title={account.address}>
                                                <span>{truncateMiddle(account.address, 8, 6)}</span>
                                            </Tooltip>
                                            <Tag
                                                color={
                                                    account.state === 'Ready' || account.state === 'WorkerIdle'
                                                        ? 'success'
                                                        : account.state === 'WorkerUnresponsive'
                                                            ? 'error'
                                                            : 'default'
                                                }
                                                style={{ margin: 0 }}
                                            >
                                                {account.state || '未知'}
                                            </Tag>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className={styles.accountMeta}>
                                            <div>
                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>余额</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.balanceFormatted} PHA</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div>
                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>累计奖励</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.totalRewardFormatted} PHA</span>

                                        <div className={styles.accountMeta}>
                                            <div>
                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>VE</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.ve || '--'}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div>
                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>评分</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.benchmarkScore || '--'}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className={styles.emptyBox}>
                                <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无账户数据</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
                            </div>
                        )}
                        {shouldPaginateAccounts && (
                            <div className={styles.accountPagination}>
                                <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    ghost
                                    disabled={incentiveAccountPage === 1}

                                >
                                    上一页
                                </Button>
                                <span>第 {incentiveAccountPage} / {incentiveAccountTotalPages} 页</span>
                                <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    type="primary"
                                    disabled={incentiveAccountPage === incentiveAccountTotalPages}
                                    onClick={() => setIncentiveAccountPage((prev) => Math.min(incentiveAccountTotalPages, prev + 1))}
                                >
                                    下一页
                                </Button>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    <DataCard
                        title="TEE可信验证"
                        titleIcon={<GlobalOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.snapshotGrid}>
                            {['SGX', 'CSV'].map((type) => {
                                const tee = dashboardData?.workers?.byTeeType?.[type as 'SGX' | 'CSV'];
                                const total = tee?.total || 0;
                                const online = tee?.online || 0;
                                const ratio = total ? Math.round((online / total) * 100) : 0;
                                return (
                                    <div key={type} className={styles.snapshotCard}>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotLabel}>{type} Worker</span>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotValue}>
                                            {online}/{total}
                                        </span>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotDesc}>在线率 {ratio || '--'}%</span>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.snapshotProgress}>
                            {['SGX', 'CSV'].map((type) => {
                                const tee = dashboardData?.workers?.byTeeType?.[type as 'SGX' | 'CSV'];
                                const total = tee?.total || 0;
                                const online = tee?.online || 0;
                                const ratio = total ? Math.round((online / total) * 100) : 0;
                                return (
                                    <div key={type} className={styles.progressItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.progressLabelRow}>
                                            <span>{type} 在线率</span>
                                            <span>{ratio || '--'}%</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                            <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${ratio}%` }} />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 中间主区域 */}
                <div className={styles.centerColumn}>
                    {/* 区块浏览器（含核心指标） */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="区块链上数据"
                        titleIcon={<TransactionOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        {/* 第一行：核心指标 */}
                        <Row gutter={[12, 12]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="区块高度"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.blockNumber || 0}
                                    prefix={<BlockOutlined />}
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#00e5ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="出块间隔"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.avgBlockTime || 0}
                                    precision={2}
                                    suffix="秒"
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="系统健康度"
                                    value={dashboardData?.system.health || 100}
                                    suffix="%"
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <Statistic
                                    title="共识节点"
                                    value={dashboardData?.blockchain.consensusNodes || 0}
                                    valueStyle={{ color: '#1890ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                />
                            </Col>
                    </Row>

                        <div className={styles.explorerToolbar}>
                            <div className={styles.viewSwitch}>
                                {explorerTabs.map((tab) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={tab.key}
                                        type="button"
                                        className={`${styles.viewSwitchButton} ${explorerView === tab.key ? styles.viewSwitchButtonActive : ''}`}
                                        onClick={() => handleExplorerViewChange(tab.key)}
                                    >
                                        {tab.label}
                                    </button>
                                ))}
                    </div>
                            <div className={styles.searchConsole}>
                                <Select
                                    value={searchType}
                                    className={styles.searchSelect}
                                    options={searchOptions}
                                    onChange={(value: ExplorerSearchType) => {
                                        setSearchType(value);
                                        setSearchError(null);
                                    }}
                                    dropdownMatchSelectWidth={false}
                                />
                                <div className={styles.searchInputGroup}>
                                    <div className={styles.searchInputWrapper}>
                                        <Input
                                            value={searchValue}
                                            onChange={(e) => {
                                                setSearchValue(e.target.value);
                                                if (searchError) {
                                                    setSearchError(null);
                                                }
                                            }}
                                            placeholder={searchPlaceholderMap[searchType]}
                                            className={styles.searchInput}
                                            allowClear
                                            bordered={false}
                                            onPressEnter={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                        />
            </div>
                                    <Button
                                        type="primary"
                                        icon={<SearchOutlined />}
                                        className={styles.searchButton}
                                        loading={searchLoading}
                                        onClick={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                    >
                                        检索
                                    </Button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {searchError && (
                            <div className={styles.searchError}>{searchError}</div>
                        )}

                        {shouldShowSearchResult && searchResult ? (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {searchResult.type === 'block' && renderBlockDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'transaction' && renderTransactionDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'account' && renderAccountDetail(searchResult.data)}
                            </div>
                        ) : explorerView === 'overview' ? (
                            <div className={styles.dualTables}>
                                {renderBlockPanel()}
                                {renderTransactionPanel()}
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {explorerView === 'blocks' ? renderBlockPanel('full') : renderTransactionPanel('full')}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 右侧列 */}
                <div className={styles.rightColumn}>
                    {/* 密钥轮换 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="密钥轮换数据"
                        titleIcon={<KeyOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow3}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总密钥数"
                                value={keyRotationData?.totalKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#722ed1', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃密钥"
                                value={keyRotationData?.activeKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="轮换中"
                                value={keyRotationData?.rotatingKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        {/* <div className={styles.rotationMetaGrid}>
                            <div className={styles.rotationMetaItem}>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaLabel}>下次轮换区块</span>
                                <div className={styles.rotationMetaValue}>#{keyRotationData?.nextRotation?.estimatedBlock || '--'}</div>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaNote}>约 {nextRotationEtaText}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className={styles.rotationMetaItem}>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaLabel}>Gatekeeper 密钥</span>
                                <div className={styles.rotationMetaValue}>{gatekeeperKeys}</div>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaNote}>正在守护</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className={styles.rotationMetaItem}>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaLabel}>待处理消息</span>
                                <div className={styles.rotationMetaValue}>{pendingMessages}</div>
                                <span className={styles.rotationMetaNote}>pRuntime 队列</span>
                            </div>
                        </div> */}
                        {/* <div className={styles.infoBox} style={{ marginTop: '12px', padding: '8px 12px' }}>
                            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                                上次轮换区块 #{keyRotationData?.lastRotation?.blockNumber || '--'} · {keyRotationData?.lastRotation?.timestamp ? new Date(keyRotationData.lastRotation.timestamp).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }) : '时间未知'}
                            </Text>
                        </div> */}
                        {keySamples.length > 0 && (
                            <>
                                <div className={styles.rotationKeyList}>
                                    {pagedKeySamples.map((key: any) => (
                                        <div key={key.id || key.keyId} className={styles.rotationKeyItem}>
                                            <div className={styles.rotationKeyHeader}>
                                                <Tooltip title={key.keyId}>
                                                    <span>{key.keyId || '--'}</span>
                                                </Tooltip>
                                                <Tag color={getKeyStatusColor(key.status)} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                                                    {key.keyType || 'SR25519'}
                                                </Tag>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className={styles.rotationKeyMeta}>
                                                <span>{truncateMiddle(key.owner, 8, 6)}</span>
                                                <span>消息 {key.pendingMessages ?? 0}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                                {keySamples.length > KEY_SAMPLE_PAGE_SIZE && (
                                    <div className={styles.rotationPagination}>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            ghost
                                            disabled={keySamplePage === 1}
                                            onClick={() => setKeySamplePage((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                                        >
                                            上一页
                                        </Button>
                                        <span>第 {keySamplePage} / {keySampleTotalPages} 页</span>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            type="primary"
                                            disabled={keySamplePage === keySampleTotalPages}
                                            onClick={() => setKeySamplePage((prev) => Math.min(keySampleTotalPages, prev + 1))}
                                        >
                                            下一页
                                        </Button>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </>
                        )}
                        {recentRotations.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.timelineList}>
                                {recentRotations.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={`${item.epoch}-${item.blockNumber}`} className={styles.timelineItem}>
                                        <div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineTitle}>Epoch {item.epoch}</div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineMeta}>区块 #{item.blockNumber}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <Tag color={item.success ? 'success' : 'error'}>
                                            {item.success ? '完成' : '失败'}
                                        </Tag>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 服务调度 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="安全调度数据"
                        titleIcon={<ThunderboltOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="资源利用率"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.systemHealth || 98}
                                suffix="%"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#13c2c2', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="平均响应时间"
                                value={workerMonitorData?.summary?.averageResponseTime || 0}
                                suffix="ms"
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.infoBox}>
                            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                                服务调度根据 Worker 在线率和响应时间动态分配任务。
                            </Text>
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.serviceGrid}>
                            {serviceInsights.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.label} className={styles.serviceTile}>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceLabel}>{item.label}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceValue}>{item.value}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.serviceDesc}>{item.desc}</div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 合约数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="智能合约数据"
                        titleIcon={<FileProtectOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总合约数"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.total || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#722ed1', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃合约"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.active || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.tagContainer}>
                            {Object.entries(dashboardData?.contracts.byType || {}).map(([type, count]) => (
                                <Tag key={type} color="purple" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                                    {type}: {count as number}
                                </Tag>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        {contractHighlights.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.contractList}>
                                {contractHighlights.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={item.type} className={styles.contractItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.contractMetaRow}>
                                            <span className={styles.contractType}>{item.type}</span>
                                            <span className={styles.contractCount}>{item.count} 个</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                            <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${item.ratio}%` }} />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

```

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.headerCenter {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    /* 移除背景、边框和阴影，只用于对齐 LOGO */
}

.subtitle {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.headerRight {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.refreshControls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn) {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    padding: 0 20px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff !important;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn:hover) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn-primary) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.timeBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
}

.timeText {
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 380px;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 数据卡片 - 使用 portalCard 风格 */
.dataCard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* 覆盖 DataCard 的样式以匹配 portal 风格 */
.dataCard :global(.card) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92)) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dataCard :global(.header) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dataCard :global(.title) {
    color: #f6f7ff !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.dataCard :global(.content) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 14px !important;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* 统计行 */
.statRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* 3列统计行 */
.statRow3 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* 4列统计行 */
.statRow4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* 修复核心指标模块的字体颜色 */
.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
}

/* 图表容器 */
.chartContainer {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.rewardChart {
    height: 120px;
    max-height: 150px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
}

/* 表格容器 */
.tableContainer {
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTableFull {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-wrapper) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-wrapper),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

.table {
    background: transparent;
}

.table :global(.ant-table) {
    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-thead > tr > th) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr:hover > td) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr) {
    height: 26px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.compactRow {
    height: 26px;
}

.compactRowEven {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.06);
}

.compactRowOdd {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.compactRow td {
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
    height: 26px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-typography) {
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-tag) {
    height: 20px;
    line-height: 18px;
    padding: 0 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
}

.dualTables {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionHeader {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionTitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.sectionSubtitle {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    max-height: 140px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);

}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-left: 4px;
}

.rewardTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.workerTable {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.workerTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    max-height: 180px;
}

.accountList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.accountItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.04);

    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.accountHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
}

.accountMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountLabel {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);

}

.accountValue {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.emptyBox {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.explorerToolbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.searchConsole {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 220px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.searchSelect {
    min-width: 88px;
    max-width: 120px;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selector) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    line-height: 34px !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selection-item) {
    line-height: 1 !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-arrow) {
    color: #fff !important;
}

.searchInputGroup {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    height: 32px !important;
}

.searchInput::placeholder {
    color: #9faecf;
}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;

}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

}

.resultLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);

}

.resultValue {

    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;

    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;

}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;

.resultListSecondary {

.resultBadge {

.resultMethod {

.resultHash {

.argItem {

}

.resultPagination {

}

.chipRow {

    flex-wrap: wrap;

    margin-top: 12px;
}

.statChip {

    min-width: 90px;

    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);

}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);

}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;
    margin-right: 12px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.snapshotProgress {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.progressItem {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.progressLabelRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.progressTrack {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {

}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {

}

.contractItem {

.contractItem .progressTrack {

}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {

    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);

}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {

}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);

}

}

.title {
