    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.accountItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.04);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.accountHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
}

.accountMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;

}

.accountLabel {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-right: 6px;
}

.accountValue {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.emptyBox {
    margin-top: 0;
}

.explorerToolbar {

}

.searchConsole {

}

.searchSelect {

}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selector) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;

    height: 34px !important;
    line-height: 34px !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;

    align-items: center !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selection-item) {

}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-arrow) {

}

.searchInputGroup {

    align-items: center;

}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;

}

.searchInput::placeholder {

}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;

    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;

    align-items: center;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {

}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);

    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;

}

.resultTag {

}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;

    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;

}

.resultLabel {

}

.resultValue {

.resultSection {

}

.resultSectionHeader {

}

.resultSectionTitle {

}

.sectionTag {

.resultList {

    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;

}

}

.resultMethod {

}

.resultPagination {

}

.chipRow {

}

.statChip {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 90px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    text-align: center;
}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;
    margin-right: 12px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(1) .snapshotValue {
    color: #ff7875;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(2) .snapshotValue {
    color: #69c0ff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(3) .snapshotValue {

}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;

}

}

.progressItem {

}

    height: 100%;

}

}

.timelineList {

    justify-content: space-between;

}

.rotationMetaGrid {

}

}

.rotationKeyList {

}

.rotationKeyItem {
    padding: 6px 8px;

.rotationKeyHeader {

.rotationKeyMeta {

.rotationPagination {

    gap: 8px;

.rotationPagination :global(.ant-btn) {

    padding: 0 10px !important;

.tablePagination,
.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountPagination {

}

.workerNotice {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    text-align: center;
}

.serviceGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.serviceTile {

}

.schedulingSummary {

    gap: 10px;
}

.summaryItem {

    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);

    gap: 4px;
}

.summaryValue {

}

.summaryLabel {
    font-size: 12px;

}

.summaryDesc {

}

.schedulingBody {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);

}

.schedulingChart,
.schedulingInsights {

}

.schedulingChart {

}

.schedulingInsights {

}

.insightTitle {
    font-size: 12px;

}

.schedulingInsights .serviceGrid {

}

@media (max-width: 1680px) {
    .schedulingBody {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {

}

.contractType {

}

.contractCount {

}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 8px 10px;
}

.contractItem .progressTrack {
    height: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.headerCenter {

    justify-content: center;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;

    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;

}

.titleLogo {

}

.subtitle {

.headerRight {

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);

.resultLabel {

}

.resultValue {
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.resultListSecondary {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.resultBadge {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.resultMethod {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.resultHash {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}

.argItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.chipRow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.statChip {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 90px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    text-align: center;
}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;

}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(1) .snapshotValue {
    color: #ff7875;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(2) .snapshotValue {
    color: #69c0ff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(3) .snapshotValue {
    color: #52c41a;
}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.snapshotProgress {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.progressItem {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.progressLabelRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.progressTrack {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progressFill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0aa2ff);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(1) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7875, #ff9a8b);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(2) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #69c0ff, #4096ff);
}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.timelineItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.timelineTitle {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.timelineMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.timelineTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaGrid {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.rotationMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.rotationMetaLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.rotationMetaNote {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationKeyList {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rotationKeyItem {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
}

.rotationKeyHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}

.rotationKeyMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.rotationPagination {
    margin-top: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.rotationPagination :global(.ant-btn) {
    height: 22px !important;
    padding: 0 10px !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
}

.tablePagination,
.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.workerNotice {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    text-align: center;
}

.serviceGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.serviceTile {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.serviceLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.serviceValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.serviceDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.schedulingSummary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
}

.summaryItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.summaryValue {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.summaryLabel {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

.summaryDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

.schedulingBody {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);
    gap: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart,
.schedulingInsights {
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    padding: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart {
    min-height: 200px;
}

.schedulingInsights {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.insightTitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.schedulingInsights .serviceGrid {
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 1680px) {
    .schedulingBody {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 8px 10px;
}

.contractItem .progressTrack {
    height: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.headerCenter {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    /* 移除背景、边框和阴影，只用于对齐 LOGO */
}

.subtitle {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.headerRight {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.refreshControls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn) {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    padding: 0 20px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff !important;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn:hover) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn-primary) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.timeBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
}

.timeText {
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 数据卡片 - 使用 portalCard 风格 */
.dataCard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* 覆盖 DataCard 的样式以匹配 portal 风格 */
.dataCard :global(.card) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92)) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dataCard :global(.header) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dataCard :global(.title) {
    color: #f6f7ff !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.dataCard :global(.content) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 14px !important;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* 统计行 */
.statRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* 3列统计行 */
.statRow3 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* 4列统计行 */
.statRow4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* 修复核心指标模块的字体颜色 */
.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
}

/* 核心指标 - 圆形样式 */
.statisticBox {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 0;
}

.statisticCircle {
    width: 110px;
    height: 110px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18), rgba(6, 11, 40, 0.65));
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 4px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15), 0 0 18px rgba(8, 17, 56, 0.6);
    text-align: center;
}

.circleIcon {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.circleValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.circleSuffix {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.circleLabel {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* 图表容器 */
.chartContainer {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.rewardChart {
    height: 120px;
    max-height: 150px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
}

/* 表格容器 */
.tableContainer {
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTableFull {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-wrapper) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-wrapper),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

.table {
    background: transparent;
}

.table :global(.ant-table) {
    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-thead > tr > th) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr:hover > td) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr) {
    height: 26px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.compactRow {
    height: 26px;
}

.compactRowEven {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.06);
}

.compactRowOdd {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.compactRow td {
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
    height: 26px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-typography) {
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-tag) {
    height: 20px;
    line-height: 18px;
    padding: 0 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
}

.dualTables {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionHeader {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionTitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.sectionSubtitle {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    max-height: 140px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-left: 4px;
}

.rewardTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.workerTable {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.workerTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    max-height: 180px;
}

.accountList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.accountItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.04);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.accountHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
}

.accountMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountLabel {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-right: 6px;
}

.accountValue {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.emptyBox {
    margin-top: 0;
}

.explorerToolbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.searchConsole {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 220px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.searchSelect {
    min-width: 88px;
    max-width: 120px;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selector) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    line-height: 34px !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selection-item) {
    line-height: 1 !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-arrow) {
    color: #fff !important;
}

.searchInputGroup {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    height: 32px !important;
}

.searchInput::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.resultValue {
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.resultListSecondary {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.resultBadge {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.resultMethod {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.resultHash {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}

.argItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.chipRow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.statChip {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 90px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    text-align: center;
}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;
    margin-right: 12px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(1) .snapshotValue {
    color: #ff7875;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(2) .snapshotValue {
    color: #69c0ff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(3) .snapshotValue {
    color: #52c41a;
}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.snapshotProgress {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.progressItem {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.progressLabelRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.progressTrack {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progressFill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0aa2ff);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(1) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7875, #ff9a8b);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(2) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #69c0ff, #4096ff);
}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.timelineItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.timelineTitle {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.timelineMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.timelineTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaGrid {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.rotationMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.rotationMetaLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.rotationMetaNote {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationKeyList {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rotationKeyItem {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
}

.rotationKeyHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}

.rotationKeyMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.rotationPagination {
    margin-top: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.tablePagination,

.serviceGrid {

}

.serviceValue {

}

.serviceDesc {

}

.schedulingSummary {
    display: grid;

    gap: 10px;
}

.summaryItem {

    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

}

.summaryValue {

}

.summaryLabel {
    font-size: 12px;

}

.summaryDesc {
    font-size: 11px;

}

.schedulingBody {
    margin-top: 12px;

    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);

}

.schedulingChart,
.schedulingInsights {

}

.schedulingChart {

}

.schedulingInsights {

}

.insightTitle {

}

.schedulingInsights .serviceGrid {
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 1680px) {
    .schedulingBody {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;

}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 8px 10px;
}

.contractItem .progressTrack {
    height: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.headerCenter {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;

}

.titleLogo {

}

.subtitle {

.headerRight {

}

/* 左右列 */

.dataCard {

}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    height: 32px !important;
}

.searchInput::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.resultValue {
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.resultListSecondary {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.resultBadge {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.resultMethod {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.resultHash {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}

.argItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.chipRow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.statChip {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 90px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    text-align: center;
}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;
    margin-right: 12px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(1) .snapshotValue {
    color: #ff7875;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(2) .snapshotValue {
    color: #69c0ff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(3) .snapshotValue {
    color: #52c41a;
}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.snapshotProgress {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.progressItem {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.progressLabelRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.progressTrack {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progressFill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0aa2ff);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(1) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7875, #ff9a8b);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(2) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #69c0ff, #4096ff);
}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.timelineItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.timelineTitle {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.timelineMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.timelineTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaGrid {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.rotationMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.rotationMetaLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.rotationMetaNote {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationKeyList {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rotationKeyItem {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
}

.rotationKeyHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}

.rotationKeyMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.rotationPagination {
    margin-top: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.rotationPagination :global(.ant-btn) {
    height: 22px !important;
    padding: 0 10px !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
}

.tablePagination,
.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.workerNotice {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    text-align: center;
}

.serviceGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.serviceTile {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.serviceLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.serviceValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.serviceDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.schedulingSummary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
}

.summaryItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.summaryValue {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.summaryLabel {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

.summaryDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

.schedulingBody {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);
    gap: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart,
.schedulingInsights {
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    padding: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart {
    min-height: 200px;
}

.schedulingInsights {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.insightTitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.schedulingInsights .serviceGrid {
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 1680px) {
    .schedulingBody {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 8px 10px;
}

.contractItem .progressTrack {
    height: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
