```typescriptreact
                                            <div>
                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>累计奖励</span>

                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>VE</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.ve || '--'}</span>
                                            </div>

                                                <span className={styles.accountLabel}>评分</span>
                                                <span className={styles.accountValue}>{account.benchmarkScore || '--'}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>

                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className={styles.emptyBox}>
                                <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无账户数据</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
                            </div>
                        )}
                        {shouldPaginateAccounts && (
                            <div className={styles.accountPagination}>
                                <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    ghost
                                    disabled={incentiveAccountPage === 1}

                                >
                                    上一页
                                </Button>
                                <span>第 {incentiveAccountPage} / {incentiveAccountTotalPages} 页</span>
                                <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    type="primary"
                                    disabled={incentiveAccountPage === incentiveAccountTotalPages}
                                    onClick={() => setIncentiveAccountPage((prev) => Math.min(incentiveAccountTotalPages, prev + 1))}
                                >
                                    下一页
                                </Button>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    <DataCard
                        title="TEE可信验证"
                        titleIcon={<GlobalOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.snapshotGrid}>
                            {['SGX', 'CSV'].map((type) => {
                                const tee = dashboardData?.workers?.byTeeType?.[type as 'SGX' | 'CSV'];
                                const total = tee?.total || 0;
                                const online = tee?.online || 0;
                                const ratio = total ? Math.round((online / total) * 100) : 0;
                                return (
                                    <div key={type} className={styles.snapshotCard}>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotLabel}>{type} Worker</span>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotValue}>
                                            {online}/{total}
                                        </span>
                                        <span className={styles.snapshotDesc}>在线率 {ratio || '--'}%</span>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.snapshotProgress}>
                            {['SGX', 'CSV'].map((type) => {
                                const tee = dashboardData?.workers?.byTeeType?.[type as 'SGX' | 'CSV'];
                                const total = tee?.total || 0;
                                const online = tee?.online || 0;
                                const ratio = total ? Math.round((online / total) * 100) : 0;
                                return (
                                    <div key={type} className={styles.progressItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.progressLabelRow}>
                                            <span>{type} 在线率</span>
                                            <span>{ratio || '--'}%</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                            <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${ratio}%` }} />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                );
                            })}
                        </div>
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 中间主区域 */}
                <div className={styles.centerColumn}>
                    {/* 区块浏览器（含核心指标） */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="区块链上数据"
                        titleIcon={<TransactionOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        {/* 第一行：核心指标 */}
                        <Row gutter={[12, 12]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <div className={styles.statisticBox}>
                                    <Statistic
                                        title="区块高度"
                                        value={dashboardData?.blockchain.blockNumber || 0}
                                        prefix={<BlockOutlined />}
                                        valueStyle={{ color: '#00e5ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <div className={styles.statisticBox}>
                                    <Statistic
                                        title="出块间隔"
                                        value={dashboardData?.blockchain.avgBlockTime || 0}
                                        precision={2}
                                        suffix="秒"
                                        valueStyle={{ color: '#faad14', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <div className={styles.statisticBox}>
                                    <Statistic
                                        title="系统健康度"
                                        value={dashboardData?.system.health || 100}
                                        suffix="%"
                                        valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </Col>
                            <Col span={6}>
                                <div className={styles.statisticBox}>
                                    <Statistic
                                        title="共识节点"
                                        value={dashboardData?.blockchain.consensusNodes || 0}
                                        valueStyle={{ color: '#1890ff', fontSize: '20px' }}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </Col>
                        </Row>

                        <div className={styles.explorerToolbar}>
                            <div className={styles.viewSwitch}>
                                {explorerTabs.map((tab) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={tab.key}
                                        type="button"
                                        className={`${styles.viewSwitchButton} ${explorerView === tab.key ? styles.viewSwitchButtonActive : ''}`}
                                        onClick={() => handleExplorerViewChange(tab.key)}
                                    >
                                        {tab.label}
                                    </button>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                            <div className={styles.searchConsole}>
                                <Select
                                    value={searchType}
                                    className={styles.searchSelect}
                                    options={searchOptions}
                                    onChange={(value: ExplorerSearchType) => {
                                        setSearchType(value);
                                        setSearchError(null);
                                    }}
                                    popupMatchSelectWidth={false}
                                />
                                <div className={styles.searchInputGroup}>
                                    <div className={styles.searchInputWrapper}>
                                        <Input
                                            value={searchValue}
                                            onChange={(e) => {
                                                setSearchValue(e.target.value);
                                                if (searchError) {
                                                    setSearchError(null);
                                                }
                                            }}
                                            placeholder={searchPlaceholderMap[searchType]}
                                            className={styles.searchInput}
                                            allowClear
                                            variant="borderless"
                                            onPressEnter={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                    <Button
                                        type="primary"
                                        icon={<SearchOutlined />}
                                        className={styles.searchButton}
                                        loading={searchLoading}
                                        onClick={() => handleSearch(1)}
                                    >
                                        检索
                                    </Button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {searchError && (
                            <div className={styles.searchError}>{searchError}</div>
                        )}

                        {shouldShowSearchResult && searchResult ? (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {searchResult.type === 'block' && renderBlockDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'transaction' && renderTransactionDetail(searchResult.data)}
                                {searchResult.type === 'account' && renderAccountDetail(searchResult.data)}
                            </div>
                        ) : explorerView === 'overview' ? (
                            <div className={styles.dualTables}>
                                {renderBlockPanel()}
                                {renderTransactionPanel()}
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className={styles.singleTableWrapper}>
                                {explorerView === 'blocks' ? renderBlockPanel('full') : renderTransactionPanel('full')}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                </div>

                {/* 右侧列 */}
                <div className={styles.rightColumn}>
                    {/* 密钥轮换 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="密钥轮换数据"
                        titleIcon={<KeyOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow3}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总密钥数"
                                value={keyRotationData?.totalKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#ff7875', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃密钥"
                                value={keyRotationData?.activeKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="轮换中"
                                value={keyRotationData?.rotatingKeys || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#69c0ff', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>

                        {keySamples.length > 0 && (
                            <>
                                <div className={styles.rotationKeyList}>
                                    {pagedKeySamples.map((key: any) => (
                                        <div key={key.id || key.keyId} className={styles.rotationKeyItem}>
                                            <div className={styles.rotationKeyHeader}>
                                                <Tooltip title={key.keyId}>
                                                    <span>{key.keyId || '--'}</span>
                                                </Tooltip>
                                                <Tag color={getKeyStatusColor(key.status)} style={{ margin: 0, minWidth: '70px', textAlign: 'center', display: 'inline-block' }}>
                                                    {key.keyType || 'SR25519'}
                                                </Tag>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className={styles.rotationKeyMeta}>
                                                <span>{truncateMiddle(key.owner, 8, 6)}</span>
                                                <span>消息 {key.pendingMessages ?? 0}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                                {keySamples.length > KEY_SAMPLE_PAGE_SIZE && (
                                    <div className={styles.rotationPagination}>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            type="primary"
                                            className={styles.paginationButton}
                                            disabled={keySamplePage === 1}
                                            onClick={() => setKeySamplePage((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                                        >
                                            上一页
                                        </Button>
                                        <span>第 {keySamplePage} / {keySampleTotalPages} 页</span>
                                        <Button
                                            size="small"
                                            type="primary"
                                            className={styles.paginationButton}
                                            disabled={keySamplePage === keySampleTotalPages}
                                            onClick={() => setKeySamplePage((prev) => Math.min(keySampleTotalPages, prev + 1))}
                                        >
                                            下一页
                                        </Button>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </>
                        )}
                        {recentRotations.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.timelineList}>
                                {recentRotations.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={`${item.epoch}-${item.blockNumber}`} className={styles.timelineItem}>
                                        <div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineTitle}>Epoch {item.epoch}</div>
                                            <div className={styles.timelineMeta}>区块 #{item.blockNumber}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <Tag color={item.success ? 'success' : 'error'}>
                                            {item.success ? '完成' : '失败'}
                                        </Tag>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 服务调度 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="安全调度数据"
                        titleIcon={<ThunderboltOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        {<div className={styles.schedulingSummary}>
                            {schedulingHighlights.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.label} className={styles.summaryItem}>
                                    <div className={styles.summaryLabel}>{item.label}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.summaryValue}>{item.value}</div>
                                    <div className={styles.summaryDesc}>{item.desc}</div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>}
                        {/* <div className={styles.schedulingBody}>
                            { <div className={styles.schedulingChart}>
                                <div className={styles.insightTitle}>状态分布</div>
                                {hasSchedulingChartData ? (
                                    <ReactECharts
                                        option={schedulingChartOption}
                                        notMerge
                                        lazyUpdate
                                        style={{ height: 150 }}
                                    />
                                ) : (
                                    <div className={styles.emptyBox} style={{ minHeight: 150 }}>
                                        <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无调度数据</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div> }
                            { <div className={styles.schedulingInsights}>
                                <div className={styles.insightTitle}>调度洞察</div>
                                {serviceInsights.length > 0 ? (
                                    <div className={styles.serviceGrid}>
                                        {serviceInsights.map((item) => (
                                            <div key={item.label} className={styles.serviceTile}>
                                                <div className={styles.serviceLabel}>{item.label}</div>

                                            </div>
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                ) : (
                                    <div className={styles.emptyBox} style={{ minHeight: 120 }}>
                                        <Empty description={<span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>暂无调度洞察</span>} image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div> }
                        </div> */}
                    </DataCard>

                    {/* 合约数据 */}
                    <DataCard
                        title="智能合约数据"
                        titleIcon={<FileProtectOutlined />}
                        className={styles.dataCard}
                    >
                        <div className={styles.statRow}>
                            <Statistic
                                title="总合约数"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.total || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#ff7875', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                            <Statistic
                                title="活跃合约"
                                value={dashboardData?.contracts.active || 0}
                                valueStyle={{ color: '#69c0ff', fontSize: '14px' }}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className={styles.tagContainer}>
                            {Object.entries(dashboardData?.contracts.byType || {}).map(([type, count]) => (
                                <Tag key={type} color="purple" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                                    {type}: {count as number}
                                </Tag>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                        {contractHighlights.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={styles.contractList}>
                                {contractHighlights.map((item) => (
                                    <div key={item.type} className={styles.contractItem}>
                                        <div className={styles.contractMetaRow}>
                                            <span className={styles.contractType}>{item.type}</span>
                                            <span className={styles.contractCount}>{item.count} 个</span>

                                        <div className={styles.progressTrack}>
                                            <div className={styles.progressFill} style={{ width: `${item.ratio}%` }} />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </DataCard>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

```

```css
/* 数据大屏样式 - 参考 portal.module.css 风格 */
.dashboardContainer {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, #3c4fa5 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #1f2758 0%, #090f2c 100%);
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    color: #fff;
}

.dashboardContainer::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(159, 44, 255, 0.45), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4), transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(70px);
    opacity: 0.95;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

.loadingContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 顶部标题栏 - 参考 portal 风格 */
.header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.headerLeft {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.headerCenter {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.heroBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: fit-content;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
}

.title {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    font-size: 32px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.titleLogo {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    /* 移除背景、边框和阴影，只用于对齐 LOGO */
}

.subtitle {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.headerRight {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.refreshControls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn) {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    padding: 0 20px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff !important;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35) !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn:hover) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15) !important;
}

.refreshControls :global(.ant-btn-primary) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.timeBadge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
}

.timeText {
    color: #00e5ff;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* 主要内容区域 */
.content {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* 左右列 */
.leftColumn,
.rightColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.leftColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.rightColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 中间主区域 */
.centerColumn {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.centerColumn::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

/* 数据卡片 - 使用 portalCard 风格 */
.dataCard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* 覆盖 DataCard 的样式以匹配 portal 风格 */
.dataCard :global(.card) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.35), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.92)) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 12px 28px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.35) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.dataCard :global(.header) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dataCard :global(.title) {
    color: #f6f7ff !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.dataCard :global(.content) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 14px !important;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* 统计行 */
.statRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* 3列统计行 */
.statRow3 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
}

/* 4列统计行 */
.statRow4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 4px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-title),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.statRow :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow3 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix),
.statRow4 :global(.ant-statistic-content-suffix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* 修复核心指标模块的字体颜色 */
.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) !important;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.centerColumn :global(.ant-statistic-content-prefix) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
}

/* 核心指标 - 长方形样式 */
.statisticBox {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.15);
    backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 94px;
}

.statisticBox :global(.ant-statistic) {
    text-align: center;
}

.statisticBox :global(.ant-statistic-title) {
    text-align: center !important;
}

.statisticBox :global(.ant-statistic-content) {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
}

/* 图表容器 */
.chartContainer {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.rewardChart {
    height: 120px;
    max-height: 150px;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
}

/* 表格容器 */
.tableContainer {
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTableFull {
    height: 320px;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-wrapper) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-wrapper),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table),
.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-container) {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.equalHeightTableFull :global(.ant-table-body) {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.tableContainer::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.7);
}

.table {
    background: transparent;
}

.table :global(.ant-table) {
    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-thead > tr > th) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}

.table :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr:hover > td) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr) {
    height: 32px !important;
}

.compactTable :global(.ant-table-tbody > tr > td) {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.compactRow {
    height: 32px;
}

.compactRowEven {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.06);
}

.compactRowOdd {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.compactRow td {
    padding: 6px 8px !important;
    height: 32px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-typography) {
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
}

.compactRow :global(.ant-tag) {
    height: 20px;
    line-height: 18px;
    padding: 0 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
}

.dualTables {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionHeader {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 12px;
}

.sectionTitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.sectionSubtitle {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    max-height: 140px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-left: 4px;
}

.rewardTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.workerTable {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.workerTable :global(.ant-table-body) {
    max-height: 180px;
}

.accountList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    max-height: 220px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.accountItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.04);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.accountHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
}

.accountMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountLabel {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-right: 6px;
}

.accountValue {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.emptyBox {
    margin-top: 0;
}

.explorerToolbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.searchConsole {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 220px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.searchSelect {
    min-width: 88px;
    max-width: 120px;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selector) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    line-height: 34px !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-selection-item) {
    line-height: 1 !important;
}

.searchSelect :global(.ant-select-arrow) {
    color: #fff !important;
}

.searchInputGroup {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
}

.searchInputWrapper {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    padding: 0 12px;
    height: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.searchInput {
    color: #fff !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    height: 32px !important;
}

.searchInput::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchInputWrapper :global(.ant-input-clear-icon) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.searchButton {
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    padding: 0 18px !important;
    height: 34px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0a5bff) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
}

.searchError {
    color: #ff7875;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tablePanel {
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12), transparent 55%),
        rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.45);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.tablePanelFull {
    width: 100%;
}

.tablePanelHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tablePanelTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.singleTableWrapper {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.viewSwitch {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.viewSwitchButton {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    min-height: 34px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.viewSwitchButton:hover {
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.viewSwitchButtonActive {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), rgba(8, 102, 255, 0.35));
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
}

.resultCard {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(8, 16, 45, 0.95), rgba(6, 21, 60, 0.9));
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 18px 32px rgba(1, 4, 18, 0.55);
    color: #fff;
}

.resultHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultTitle {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.resultSubtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.resultTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: none;
}

.resultMetaGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.resultMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.resultValue {
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultSection {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.resultSectionHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.resultSectionTitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.sectionTag {
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 0;
    border: none;
}

.resultList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.resultListItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.resultListPrimary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.resultListSecondary {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.resultBadge {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.resultMethod {
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.resultHash {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);

}

.argItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    font-size: 12px;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.resultPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.chipRow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.statChip {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 90px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
    text-align: center;
}

.chipLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chipSub {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rewardList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.rewardItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.rewardAmount {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffd666;
    margin-right: 12px;
}

.rewardMeta {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.rewardTime {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.snapshotGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.snapshotCard {
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.snapshotLabel {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.snapshotValue {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ffffff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(1) .snapshotValue {
    color: #ff7875;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(2) .snapshotValue {
    color: #69c0ff;
}

.snapshotCard:nth-child(3) .snapshotValue {
    color: #52c41a;
}

.snapshotDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.snapshotProgress {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.progressItem {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.progressLabelRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.progressTrack {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progressFill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #0aa2ff);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(1) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7875, #ff9a8b);
}

.snapshotProgress .progressItem:nth-child(2) .progressFill {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #69c0ff, #4096ff);
}

.timelineList {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.timelineItem {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.timelineTitle {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.timelineMeta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.timelineTime {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaGrid {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.rotationMetaItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.rotationMetaLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationMetaValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.rotationMetaNote {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.rotationKeyList {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rotationKeyItem {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.05);
}

.rotationKeyHeader {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}

.rotationKeyMeta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.rotationPagination {
    margin-top: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.tablePagination,
.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.accountPagination {
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.paginationButton {
    min-width: 70px !important;
    height: 24px !important;
    padding: 0 10px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
}

.paginationButton:disabled,
.paginationButton[disabled] {
    background: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.55) !important;
    border-color: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.55) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

.paginationButton:disabled:hover,
.paginationButton[disabled]:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.55) !important;
    border-color: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.55) !important;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) !important;
}

.workerNotice {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    text-align: center;
}

.serviceGrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.serviceTile {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08);
}

.serviceLabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.serviceValue {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
}

.serviceDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.schedulingSummary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
}

.summaryItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.summaryValue {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #00e5ff;
}

.summaryLabel {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

.summaryDesc {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

.schedulingBody {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr);
    gap: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart,
.schedulingInsights {
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    padding: 12px;
}

.schedulingChart {
    min-height: 200px;
}

.schedulingInsights {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.insightTitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.schedulingInsights .serviceGrid {
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 1680px) {
    .schedulingBody {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.contractList {
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.contractMetaRow {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.contractType {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.contractCount {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

/* 标签容器 */
.tagContainer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.tagContainer :global(.ant-tag) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) !important;
    color: #00e5ff !important;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
}

.contractItem {
    padding: 8px 10px;
}

.contractItem .progressTrack {
    height: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* 信息框 */
.infoBox {
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.infoBox :global(.ant-typography) {
    color: rgba(243, 246, 255, 0.85) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* 响应式设计 */
@media (max-width: 1920px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr 360px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1600px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 340px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 12px 24px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1366px) {
    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 320px;
    }

    .header {
        padding: 10px 20px;
    }
}

/* 动画效果 */
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.dataCard {
    animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

/* 增强视觉效果 */
.dataCard :global(.card):hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 16px 40px rgba(1, 3, 13, 0.45) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(86, 111, 196, 0.4), rgba(17, 23, 55, 0.95)) !important;
}
```
